9.
By way of this application, the counsel for the appellant prayed for stay of the impugned judgment dated 15.01.2024.

10. Let the operation of the impugned judgment dated 15.01.2024 shall remain stayed, subject to the deposition of entire decretal amount within 08 weeks from today.
11.
The application stands disposed of.

seeking further enhancement in compensation amount and modification to the extent thereof in the impugned judgment arising out of the award bearing no. 19/2005-06/DC(NW) pertaining to village Bawana, Delhi.
